intro: Ivory Coast has about 31 million people from over 60 ethnic groups.

chapters.title: People
text: Groups include the Akan, Krou, Mandé and Voltaic peoples. French is official, and Dioula is widely used in markets. Christianity and Islam are both large religions.
Many people from Burkina Faso and Mali have moved here to work.

chapters.title: Abidjan
text: Abidjan is the biggest city and business capital; Yamoussoukro is the official capital.

keyTerms.meaning: Abidjan's slang, mixing French and local languages.
